lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task: plan: the capstone design

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to plan before computing anything.

items.prompt: A triangle where one angle measures more than 90° is called what kind of triangle?

steps: One angle over 90° makes it an obtuse triangle.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
A triangle where all three sides are the same length is called what kind of triangle?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will figure out, how, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle (non-square) have?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A triangle where all three angles measure less than 90° is called what kind of triangle?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
